If you sell digital products, these are 3 legal documents you need to know about, and most sellers completely overlook number 3 👀 1️⃣ Digital Product Purchase Agreement This can establish the terms of the purchase, including restrictions on sharing or reselling your digital product and other important purchase terms. 2️⃣ Website/Store Terms & Conditions Your Terms & Conditions establish the rules for your online business and can address things like refunds, intellectual property, and limitations of liability. 3️⃣ Content Usage License If a brand or client pays to use your videos, templates, graphics, courses, or other content, a content usage license can clearly define how they can use it, where, for how long, and what happens if they go beyond those rights. Your creativity is an asset. Treat it like one. 💅🏾 And no, you don't necessarily need to spend hundreds on legal fees just to get foundational documents in place.
